description.value: The Basic Eats is a casual all-day breakfast and lunch spot with three Vancouver locations, emphasizing affordable prices, generous portions, and locally sourced ingredients. The Main Street location sits in one of Vancouver's most bicycle-friendly corridors, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists. The menu leans heavily on egg dishes, griddle items, and Eggs Benedict variations, with a solid selection of vegetarian options throughout.
